== Title ==
<span lang="ja">レッド１</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-144o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">パイロットを１名追加してよい。戦闘力、回避値、航行速度を使うためには、パイロットが乗っていなければならない。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">ヤヴィンの戦いのレッド飛行中隊リーダー機。ガーヴェン・ドライスが操縦。ダントゥインの反乱軍本部にも配備されたことがある。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title:''' Red 1.

'''Card text:''' May add one pilot. A pilot must be aboard to use power, maneuver, or hyperspeed.

'''Lore:''' Red Squadron's lead ship at the Battle of Yavin, piloted by Garven Dreis. It had also been stationed at the Rebel headquarters on Dantooine.
